_comment: The fixed weekly panel. Keep keywords stable: a changed keyword starts a new series, so add rather than edit. competitors are products only (apps or services that do what ours does); the first one is the report's main rival. Blogs, guides and platforms that only rank for the topic go under ignored_domains, so the Competitors page stops suggesting them. Pick competitors from the first run's 'Other domains in the top 20', checking each site. index_sample_pattern: optional URL part of a page kind too numerous to inspect every week (e.g. /question/).
